components.title: Litany Engine Ossuary
components.text: The location behaves like a devotional machine built from arranged remains.

components.title: Bone-Dust Breath
components.text: The air carries a dry mineral taste of powdered bone.

components.title: Clicking Skull Seams
components.text: Tiny clicks move through the walls whenever the room goes quiet.

components.title: Prayer-Slip Mortar
components.text: The mortar is packed with folded prayer slips and pale hair.

components.title: Weight-Sermon Slab
components.text: A pressure slab releases hanging bonework when crossed carelessly.

components.title: Reliquary Tripwire
components.text: A thread of rosary beads pulls open a reliquary of sharp fragments.
